markets.description: This market resolves Yes only if the exact letter sequence 'Manchester City' is recorded in the official Hansard transcript of a Prime Minister's Questions session, and that transcript is published before November 5, 2026 at 13:00 UTC. The sequence must appear letter for letter. Any wording that contains 'Manchester City' counts, including 'Manchester City FC' and 'Manchester City Council'. 'Man City', 'the city of Manchester', and any other wording that does not contain that exact sequence do not count. Resolution is based only on the transcript of the Prime Minister's Questions session itself (the Engagements / Prime Minister’s Questions block). Mentions outside that session do not count. Written ministerial statements or questions submitted in writing do not count. Video, subtitles, and other sources do not count. Primary source: Hansard UK (https://hansard. parliament. uk). If the primary source is unavailable, incomplete, or inconsistent at the time of resolution, resolution falls back to the official PMQs transcript on UK Parliament (https://www. parliament. uk). The primary source governs. Video alone does not resolve the market. Resolution is based on the transcript as published before the deadline, including the provisional ('rolling') version if that is the version published before November 5, 2026 at 13:00 UTC. Anything published after that time does not count: a sequence added after the deadline does not resolve the market Yes, and deletion after the deadline of a sequence already published before the deadline does not reverse a Yes. If no published PMQs transcript contains the exact sequence before the deadline, the market resolves No. If the scheduled PMQs sessions are permanently cancelled without taking place, or the official record is permanently retracted before the deadline so that no transcript is published, the market voids and all positions resolve equally.

Illness without an injury label, rest/rotation, suspension, personal reasons, and unconfirmed media reports do not count. A pre-existing injury mentioned again does not count unless an official source states a new injury or setback in the window. Primary sources: Rockstar/Take-Two for the launch date; Manchester United, The FA, or Shaw’s verified official channels for the injury. markets.pitch: YES. First PL win in 25 years bought him time. Nobody sacks the man who won them the Championship.
markets.description:
This market refers to whether Frank Lampard remains Coventry City’s first-team manager through 23:59 UTC on 6 November 2026. It resolves on whether Coventry City or the Premier League has officially announced before that deadline that he is leaving the role.

Yes resolves if, at 23:59 UTC on 6 November 2026, Frank Lampard is Coventry City’s first-team manager and no departure has been officially announced. A temporary absence, such as illness or a touchline ban, does not count as leaving.

No resolves if, before 23:59 UTC on 6 November 2026, Coventry City or the Premier League officially announces that Lampard is leaving the role. This covers being sacked, resigning, or leaving by mutual consent, and it applies even if the departure takes effect after 6 November. 

Resolution will be based on official announcements from Coventry City or the Premier League as the primary source. BBC Sport or Sky Sports will be used as a secondary source only if the official announcement is not available on the primary sources within a timely manner, and only if they quote or link it. A later reversal or delay does not change the result once a qualifying departure has been announced. If no official record can reasonably establish Lampard’s status by the deadline, the market will be voided.
